status_note: The four-line covered projection matches Varnode::getUsePoint (varnode.cc:690-703) on the locked Ghidra 12.0.4: the written leg returns the defining op address, and the input/free legs return the fd.getAddress()+-1 sentinel, including the ram:0 underflow wrap through AddrSpace::wrapOffset. Downstream consumers (setVarnodeProperties queryProperties, Scope::inUse, findLinkedVarnodes) are exercised end-to-end by the curl/httpd differential gates, not by this fixture.

architecture.spaces: const=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, stack=5, join=6, iop=7; byte addressed; the Rust side builds the same SpaceRegistry and tags the Funcdata base address with the ram handle so space identity is projected unnormalized

compiler_spec.calling_convention: empty input/output records; no effects, symbols, or injections

analysis_options.api: Direct production Varnode::get_use_point calls; no Action or Rule runs
analysis_options.funcdata: Fresh synthetic Funcdata per base address; high-level mode disabled
analysis_options.ir: COPY(unique-out,4) at ram:0x2000 with constant 7; register-space varnodes at 0x40/0x50/0x60 for the input/free/zero-base cases
analysis_options.normalization: None. The emitted projection prints the use-point space name and hex offset. Space identity is compared for real (both sides carry ram).

input_manifest.canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(cases, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)

cases.ir: Funcdata based at ram:0x1000; COPY(unique-out) at ram:0x2000; the unique out is written
same Funcdata; register:0x40 four-byte input varnode via setInputVarnode
same Funcdata; register:0x50 four-byte varnode, never written, never marked input
second Funcdata based at ram:0; register:0x60 free varnode

observation_schema.format: Four fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline
observation_schema.fields: case, leg, use-point space name, use-point hex offset

decisive_semantics.references_and_outputs: MATCH for all four cases: getUsePoint returns an Address by value carrying the fd/def-op space and offset; no state mutation.
decisive_semantics.sort_and_comparison_keys: MATCH: the sentinel arithmetic fd.getAddress()+-1 goes through Address::operator+ (address.hh:423) and AddrSpace::wrapOffset on both sides; the ram:0 base wraps to 0xffffffffffffffff on both.

downstream_consumers.scope: setVarnodeProperties/Scope::inUse/findLinkedVarnodes are covered by the curl/httpd differential gates, outside this fixture's domain
